# Boxting Labs

> Boxting Labs is a boutique software and AI engineering studio based in Lima, Peru, founded in 2018. We design and build custom software, applied AI and cloud infrastructure around the way a client's operation already works — "software that bends to your process, not the other way around." We serve companies in Latin America and the United States, and deliberately take on only a few projects a year.

The site is bilingual: Spanish at https://www.boxtinglabs.com/ and English at https://www.boxtinglabs.com/en/. All work is delivered directly by the studio.

## Practice

- Custom software engineering: web and mobile applications end-to-end — architecture, product design, implementation and production launch.
- AI-powered automation: language models and agents integrated into business processes — operations automation, internal assistants, intelligent search and measurable workflows.
- Cloud infrastructure for product: AWS or GCP architecture, continuous deployment, observability and cost control.
- Consulting and technical training: architecture review, engineering practice and tailored training for internal teams.

## Selected work

- [Ava Cash](https://ava.pe/): savings app (iOS and Android) for Ava, a service station network in Peru. Flutter, Node.js, AWS, PostgreSQL. 2025.
- [Jalhuca](https://jalhuca.com/es/): offline-first field app for an organic fruit producer and exporter in Spain and Peru. Flutter. 2024.
- [New Transport](https://www.newtransport.net/): quoting panel and real-time cargo tracking platform for a perishable cargo logistics operator in Peru. Next.js, Express, PostgreSQL. 2025.

## How we work

- Few clients, deep care: we stay involved in decisions, detail and what happens after launch.
- Direct, written communication — one page, not a deck.
- Long-term engagements with active clients.
